messages:
Aisha: Heads-up: attach failures and long attach tails in eu-west3 for a tiny set of scratch nodes. Graphs line up with a sudden NVMe background-scrub ramp.
Tom: which nodes/pool? scrub scheduled or firmware-triggered?
Aisha: pool=cohort-e (gnode-eu3-30[1-3]). Looks firmware-triggered when temp > 64C; drives enter heavy background-scan.
Diego: do we see SMART or read errors?
Aisha: no SMART, no readonly. Just high write-amplification and io_waits causing the attach coordinator retries. Attach success rate fine but tail latency up ~3-5x.
Sofia: can janitor throttle the scrub for that pool while we divert new GPU attaches?
Aisha: plan: set janitor concurrency=1 for cohort-e, cap io to 50% for that pool, and add a smart-router deprioritize rule for gnode-eu3-30*. That should reduce attach tails quickly.
Tom: what's the customer impact if we prefer other regions? latency + cost?
Aisha: small latency bump (~10-30ms) for affected customers, minor egress increase for control plane. Still better than widespread attach queueing.
Diego: also open vendor bug for firmware fw-2025-11 in eu-west3 and include dmesg + WA samples.
Aisha: executing now: 
# throttle janitor for cohort-e
jq '.pools["cohort-e"].concurrency=1 | .pools["cohort-e"].max_io_bytes=0.5' /etc/janitor/config.yaml > /tmp/janitor.patch && sudo mv /tmp/janitor.patch /etc/janitor/config.yaml && sudo systemctl reload janitor
# deprioritize nodes in router
redis-cli HSET router:node_weights "gnode-eu3-30" 0.03

janitor-bot: updated janitor config for cohort-e (concurrency=1, max_io_bytes=50%). change rolling apply ~60s.
Aisha: router weights applied. tail latency down ~45% after 90s. I'll file INF-4590 and attach logs.
Sofia: add a temp cron to ramp concurrency back gradually when temps <60C for 30m. Also run a staging rollback test of fw-2025-11 on a spare node.
Diego: i'll calculate the 24h cross-region cost delta vs SLA risk for the postmortem.
Aisha: thanks everyone. monitoring will stay on; i'll escalate if SMARTs show up or a node flips readonly. :thumbsup:
